julia: FYI compliance just asked for a quarterly admin-attestation sweep across all orgs. Asking security to run a lightweight prune and collect ownerproof for each binding. cesar: Ok. Rough scope? org-level owners, project-admin roles, KMS key-admins, and svcacct admin bindings? julia: Exactly. Also include service principals that are only used by scheduled jobs. We need to avoid blind removals. anya: Can we do an initial filter: idle >120d AND not referenced in crondb AND not in any recent deploy manifests? That should cut false positives. tariq: I'll add crondb and deploy index checks. Also suggest adding a monthly-schedule allowance: if cron shows monthly job, skip and flag for manual review. auditbot: scan-run complete. totals: ownerless:58, idle_admins_120d:287, kms_admins_with_keys:31. report: https://internal-storage/reports/attest-sweep-1751112222.csv julia: Good. Outreach pattern: 48h owner response window. If no response, create a JIRA ticket for review and schedule canary removal for low-risk projects. cesar: Draft outreach DM: ```Hi <@owner>, we found an admin binding on inactive for >120 days. Please reply KEEP within 48h to retain or REVOKE to approve removal. If uncertain, reply HELP. Evidence: ``` anya: Add an audit note if project log retention <90d. We need 90d to prove inactivity. If logs short, snapshot now and file logging infra ticket. tariq: KMS note: before touching any principal with KMS roles, run `kms-check --principal

--keys-file keys.list --simulate` and `decrypt-sample --key --ciphertext samples/`. If either fails, do not remove binding. julia: Good. Who will run KMS sims? anya: I'll take KMS simulations and sample decrypts. I'll post failures to this thread. cesar: Canary plan: pick 10 low-risk bindings from non-prod and infra namespaces, run removals one-by-one over 24h with health checks in between. If any decrypt error or service alert, immediately rollback and escalate. tariq: Rollback steps (short): 1) `rbac-restore --id ` 2) re-run impacted service healthchecks 3) clear incident when green. Post incident to #oncall if rollback needed. auditbot: retention-check: found projects with <90d retention: ci-build, perf-qa, dev-labs. Created tickets: LOG-452, LOG-453, LOG-454. julia: Also ensure we gather ownerproof artifact for each binding: `rbac-export --binding --format csv --out /artifacts/ownerproof-.csv`. That CSV goes into the compliance bundle. cesar: Timeline: outreach starts today, reminders at 24h and 40h, canary starts in 72h, bulk prune at +7 days if no major flags. auditbot: reminders scheduled. anya: Edge-case: some SAs call into external partners (thirdparty keys) and show no activity internally. We'll add a partner-access check to avoid breaking integrations. julia: Add `--partner-check` to the scan pipeline. tariq: I'll build a lightweight dashboard showing binds by last_active, owner status, and KMS-sim outcome so compliance can watch progress. cesar: Uploading outreach CSV and evidence snapshots to secure share: https://internal-storage/outreach/attest-1751112222.csv julia: Recording owners for the run: outreach=cesar, kms/crypt=anya, canary= t ariaq? (typo fixed) canary=tariq, evidence_bundle=julia. If someone swaps, update this thread. cesar: small change to DM: add fallback contact security@redwood.com and instructions for urgent keep requests. julia: Done. Let's keep communication strict: any KMS-sim failure = immediate pause. We'll reconvene in 72h with canary results. Thanks all :rocket:
